meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个闪电图标,用绿点/红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行,点击后可启动、停止或重启服务。仅支持 macOS,需安装 Xcode 命令行工具。
howto.when: 当用户在 macOS 上要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态图标,或想要查看运行状态并控制启动、停止时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 在菜单栏加上状态图标,显示绿点/红点运行状态。
say.note: 会检查 macOS 和 swiftc,然后编译安装。

say.text: 让 NanoClaw 在菜单栏显示运行状态,并提供启动、停止和重启。
say.note: 会创建 launchd 服务并加载启动。

say.text: 帮我安装 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态指示器。
say.note: 若已安装会直接跳到验证步骤。

howto.what_en: Adds a macOS menu bar bolt icon with a green/red dot showing if NanoClaw is running; click for Start, Stop, Restart. macOS only, needs Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw on macOS, or to show its running state with start/stop controls.

say_en.text: Add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw showing a green/red dot.
say_en.note: Checks macOS and compiles the indicator.

say_en.text: Make NanoClaw appear in the menu bar with Start, Stop, and Restart.
say_en.note: Installs a launchd service and loads it.

say_en.text: Install the NanoClaw status indicator in the menu bar.
